label: run140 storage credit isolation
definition: PROBE (diagnostic, NOT a keeper). Isolates the STORAGE-only measured-2023 reserve credit on the run134 ccsteam-derate baseline (--ercot-storage-as-reserve-from-year 2023, load credit OFF), on the measured 2023 storage-AS series (1.25 GW). Sits between main's run138 (uncredited: 2023 58.4, 210/130 over actual 181/104) and run137 (load+storage credit: 27.0, 33/15): storage-only credit gives 2023 avg 31.6, tail 61/34 — the physically-correct storage-reserve accounting reproduces only ~34%/33% of actual >200/>500, so ~2/3 of the 2023 tail is out-of-market administrative scarcity no ORDC/LOLP curve can make. Confirms the storage-reserve global flip stays rejected; the measured 2023 LOAD-resource credit (not storage reserve) is the right offset and IS adopted in the run139 KEEPER. 2024 avg 22.5 (act 26.8), 13/5 over-cools; 2025 38.0 (act 32.5), 18/9 = run134 ccsteam re-inflation.
